## Description

Checks the deposit's R code and R data files:

- `tools/check_rds_files.R` checks R data files: `generated/r-data-checks.csv` and `.md`.
- `tools/check_r_deps.R` finds the packages the code loads: `generated/r-deps.csv`, `generated/r-deps-summary.csv`, and their `.md` versions.
- When packages were found, writes `generated/software-warnings-r.md`, a note that [24_amend_report.sh](#help-24_amend_report) puts at the top of the report.
- When a `renv.lock` file is found (up to four levels deep), runs [find_cran_date.py](#help-find_cran_date) to write `generated/notes-for-r.md`.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/14_run_r_scanner.sh <projectID>
```

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `ProcessR` - When `no`, the script exits immediately.
